source_item.title: Dollar flat for the week as elevated rate hike bets offset U.S.-Iran peace hopes

card.plain_headline: Dollar steady as rate hike bets counter Iran peace hopes

card.what_happened_verbose: The U.S. dollar index (DXY) has seen little movement over the past week. This stability is due to opposing market forces. Higher interest rates generally make a currency more attractive to investors. On the other hand, there were reports suggesting potential diplomatic progress or de-escalation of tensions between the U.S. and Iran, which could reduce geopolitical risk and potentially weaken the safe-haven demand for the dollar.
